name: rempart-backup
description: Plugin WordPress de sauvegarde, restauration et migration, sans licence ni verrou.

scripts.services:up: docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.yml up -d && node tools/init-services.js
scripts.test:destinations: node tools/connect-network.js && npx --yes @wordpress/env@12 run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/rempart-backup/tests/integration/destinations.php
scripts.test:notifications: node tools/connect-network.js && npx --yes @wordpress/env@12 run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/rempart-backup/tests/integration/notifications.php
scripts.test:backups: node tools/connect-network.js && npx --yes @wordpress/env@12 run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/rempart-backup/tests/integration/backups.php
